what: Most of the EU AI Act starts to apply
note: The remainder of the Act takes effect apart from one article, and every member state must by this date have at least one national AI regulatory sandbox operating.

when_text: August 2026, exact date not yet set
what: Australian national cabinet takes up mandatory data centre standards
note: The Prime Minister said on 15 July he would seek agreement from premiers and chief ministers for mandatory standards covering power supply, connection costs and water efficiency, with legislation to follow early next year.

Palau hosts for the first time since 2014, with eighteen member states meeting under the 2050 Strategy for the Blue Pacific Continent; Forum ICT ministers put artificial intelligence on the regional agenda in July.

what: 4th UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of AI
note: Co-hosted by UNESCO and Saudi Arabia under the theme of transforming global cooperation for ethical AI governance; UNESCO says registration details are still to come.
Held as a hybrid meeting, so it can be joined without travelling; the theme and the calls for session proposals had not been published at the time of this scan.

what: South Africa reopens public comment on its National AI Policy
note: The April 2026 draft was withdrawn and a revised policy is expected at Cabinet by November 2026 before a fresh comment period opens, so this is a door that has been announced rather than one you can walk through yet.

when_text: May 2027, exact dates not yet set
what: Second session of the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance
note: The first session in Geneva drew criticism from civil society coalitions that women and Indigenous Peoples were insufficiently represented, which makes how this one is convened worth watching.

what: No open consultation found that a member of the public could answer today
note: Every AI consultation traced in this scan had already closed: Ireland in April, Canada in March, the EU transparency guidelines in June and the EU high-risk classification guidelines on 23 July. The next announced opening is South Africa in January 2027.
